D5/S3/QuantumBounds/CollisionEntropyUnce.signature: theorem collision_entropy_uncertainty {d : Nat} (hd : 0 < d) (p : Fin (d + 1) -> Fin d -> Real) (purity : Real) (hprob : forall b, (forall i, 0 <= p b i) /\ ∑ i, p b i = 1) (hcollision : ∑ b, ∑ i, (p b i) ^ 2 = 1 + purity) : (d + 1 : Real) * Real.log ((d + 1 : Real) / (1 + purity)) <= ∑ b, shannonEntropy (p b)
